name: build-fleet
description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house. Ships product-owner, architect, coder, qa, devops, scribe, and classifier subagents that execute a deterministic SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF state machine. v0.4 adds a product tier above the feature loop: a PLAN → PLAN_REVIEW → PLAN_FINALIZE → DEVELOPING machine where the plan is interrogated (not survival-voted) and ratified by a human, features inherit the binding stack-of-record + a per-feature intent, and a DEVELOPING loop advances the backlog. REVIEW and PLAN_REVIEW run as Claude Code dynamic workflows; BUILD can fan out across partitioned coders. Hook-enforced gates, bounded review cycles, first-class human escalation/ratification, headless-mode support for orchestrators (Hermes / Agent SDK). v0.5 adds a parallel troubleshoot-fix bug lane (REPORT → REPRODUCE → DIAGNOSE → FIX → VERIFY → HANDOFF) whose contract is a diagnosis.md, not a spec: an inviolable reproducing-test gate, a CONFIRMED source-write unlock, an inverted-review.js diagnosis-confirmation workflow, and severity-driven tempo with a sev0 hotfix fast-path.
